data.name: Home.Principle.Architecture.Text
data.value: I design boundaries before writing code: clean layering, explicit contracts and a domain that is easy to test.

data.name: Home.Principle.Automation.Text
data.value: Pipelines build, test and deploy every change. If a step is manual, it will eventually be forgotten.

data.name: Home.Principle.Performance.Text
data.value: Fast APIs and pre-rendered UIs. This site ships zero JavaScript on purpose.

data.name: Home.Cta.Text
data.value: I'm available for senior .NET roles and architecture-focused work. Tell me about your product and the problems you want to leave behind.

data.name: About.Lead
data.value: Backend platforms, APIs, Blazor front-ends and MAUI apps — always with maintainability as the acceptance criterion.

data.name: About.Bio.Heading
data.value: I build software that survives its authors

data.name: About.Bio.P1
data.value: I'm a senior .NET developer with more than {0} years shipping systems that companies run their day on: backend platforms, internal and public APIs, Blazor front-ends and cross-platform mobile apps.

data.name: About.Bio.P2
data.value: My sweet spot is the space between architecture and delivery. Clean Architecture, CQRS and Domain-Driven Design are tools I use because they make change cheap — never as ceremony. I favour a small number of clear boundaries, explicit contracts and tests that document intent.

data.name: About.Bio.P3
data.value: On the cloud side I work mainly with Azure: App Service, Functions, Service Bus, Azure SQL and pipelines in Azure DevOps. I treat observability, accessibility and performance as features from day one, not as a hardening phase.

data.name: About.Timeline.Subtitle
data.value: From electronics repair to leading development teams: the path that shaped how I build software.

data.name: Architecture.Solid.Title
data.value: Five principles, verified in the code

data.name: Architecture.Solid.Subtitle
data.value: Concrete evidence from this codebase for every letter.

data.name: Architecture.Quality.Subtitle
data.value: If a rule matters, it fails the build instead of living in a wiki.

data.name: Architecture.Layer.Presentation.Text
data.value: Razor components and pages render HTML only. They own no business decisions.

data.name: Architecture.Layer.Application.Text
data.value: Pages send queries through the mediator; handlers orchestrate the use case.

data.name: Architecture.Layer.Domain.Text
data.value: Strategies, factories and builders turn domain data into presentation models.

data.name: Architecture.Layer.Infrastructure.Text
data.value: Repositories provide the data behind interfaces, today from static catalogues.

data.name: Architecture.Solid.S.Text
data.value: One reason to change per class: strategies render, factories map, repositories supply data.

data.name: Architecture.Solid.O.Text
data.value: New technology categories only require a new strategy; no existing class is modified.

data.name: Architecture.Solid.L.Text
data.value: Every repository and strategy implementation honours its interface contract.

data.name: Architecture.Solid.I.Text
data.value: Small, purpose-specific interfaces such as IProjectRepository or ISkillRepository.

data.name: Architecture.Solid.D.Text
data.value: Pages depend on IMediator and services depend on abstractions, never on concretions.

data.name: Architecture.Quality.EditorConfig
data.value: EditorConfig style enforced at build time

data.name: Architecture.Quality.StaticExport
data.value: Static export verified route by route
